note_tweet.text:
Jason Calacanis says he spends under $40K a year on AI and gets $2M+ in value back.

Everyone is quoting the 50x. That's the wrong number.

The real number is this one: his team says it has automated at least 7 full-time jobs and become about 2x faster at the average task.

So the honest comparison isn't $40K vs $2M. It's $40K vs seven salaries.

Even at a modest $60K per role, that's $420K of payroll replaced by tokens and subscriptions. Roughly a 10x on cost alone, before you count speed.

What his stack tells you:
- Anthropic for reasoning and code
- Lovable for building apps
- Grok Bot for agents that do the work
- ElevenLabs for voice
- a long tail of smaller tools

No single model. A stack of agents, each doing one job well.

He also says the last 90 days changed more than the previous two years, and if you haven't used these tools 30+ hours a week, you don't get it yet. I agree with the first part. The jump from "chatbot" to "agent that finishes the task" happened fast.

But here's what nobody in the replies is pricing in:

1. That ROI depends on cheap tokens. Subscription limits are tightening and usage-based pricing is spreading. If token costs go up 3x, the math still works, but the margin shrinks.

2. The $2M is his estimate. No breakdown, no method. Treat it as a direction, not an audit.

3. The winners won't be the ones spending the most. They'll be the ones who know exactly which seven jobs to hand off.

My take: by the end of 2027, "AI spend per employee" will be a line every founder reports, right next to payroll.

What's your yearly AI spend, and what did it actually replace?

我以前真以为换到这里就能畅所欲言，结果真把规则摸透了，才发现这里的黑色幽默比哪儿都耐人寻味。
马斯克天天把言论自由挂在嘴边，算法却在背地里给我上一套极其体面的赛博消音术。
我好心发个帖子分析交易所的暴雷内幕、清算风险，劝大家做好自我托管，结果算法转手就把我归类为“潜在金融风险”，推荐优先级瞬间被踩到了地心，评论区里那些拉盘发假币的诈骗Bot到处乱窜没人管，我认真给人递个安全帽，反倒成了算法眼里的有害生物。
更讽刺的是聊现实经济议题，只要我稍微碰一下社保压力、地方财政或者体制批评，那套所谓的“可见性过滤”立刻精准降临。
它显得特别文明：既不删我的帖子，也不封我的账号，就是悄悄把自然分发上限锁死在冰点，让我这辈子都别想挤进更大的推荐池。
搞得我现在码字就像在搞赛博避谶，稍微把“币安”、“清算”、“拔网线”或者“社保”、“体制”这几个词组合着高频出现，系统立马判定我是高风险争议内容，直接在For You推荐和搜索结果里让我凭空消失。
我每个月交着认证税，以为自己买了一张在广场发声的扩音门票，结果平台只是把我的隔音玻璃糊得更严实了。我在这里确实享有把喉咙喊破的自由，而算法拥有把我的麦克风悄悄拔掉、让我对着空气自说自话的绝对特权。
@grok  你说我说的对不对，不对我给你道歉！！
